scope: Installation of one factory-assembled variable-speed potable-water booster skid BPS-SKID-Q90-H45-2D1S inside an existing prepared pump room, with three 30 kW vertical multistage pumps in a two-duty plus one-standby arrangement, 6 m DN200 suction manifold, 8 m DN150 discharge manifold, two 1000 l pressure vessels and 160 m internal power cable. Skid accessories, anchors and grout, electrical-controls, testing, disinfection, labor, equipment and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved potable-water pressure-booster hydraulic calculation, factory skid data sheet and GA, pump-room coordination drawings, mechanical and electrical schedules, controls narrative, commissioning and disinfection program, suppliers and approving project engineer

conditionalBranches.roomVentilationUpgrade: NOT_REQUIRED unless the approved heat-gain and room-ventilation calculation requires it
conditionalBranches.floorStrengthening: NOT_REQUIRED unless the approved structural verification requires it
conditionalBranches.standbyGenerator: NOT_REQUIRED unless the approved electrical reliability category requires it

exclusions: freestanding pumping-station building, excavation, foundation structure and external utility works
sewer wet-well station, fire pump station and process-water pumping equipment
count-derived valves, connectors, grout, instruments, labor, equipment or logistics
unapproved room alterations, electrical supply, equipment or prices
